LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction01.label: Order
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction01.description: A militant brotherhood devoted to a strict code of honor and the protection of sanctuaries. Knights in shining armor carry the banner of faith and sword.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction02.label: Union
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction02.description: An alliance of cities and craft guilds, founded on trade agreements and mutual protection. Wealth and diplomacy are their main weapons.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction03.label: Dynasty
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction03.description: An ancient line of rulers whose blood reigns for centuries. Intrigues, dynastic marriages, and an iron will to power shape their history.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction04.label: Principality
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction04.description: A mighty principality with a rich history of knightly tournaments, trade, and conquests. Strong castles and loyal vassals guard their borders.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction05.label: Kingdom
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction05.description: A great kingdom with a splendid court and a powerful army. Kings rule with an iron fist, maintaining balance between nobility and church.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction06.label: Barony
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction06.description: A militant barony where the strength of arms outweighs diplomacy. Barons personally lead troops into battle, defending their lands from raids.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction07.label: Duchy
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction07.description: A wealthy and cultured duchy renowned for art, architecture, and subtle diplomacy. Dukes weave complex political webs.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction08.label: County
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction08.description: A trading county at the crossroads of routes. Caravans, markets, and hired crossbowmen ensure prosperity and safety.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction09.label: Domain
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction09.description: A vast domain ruled by a mighty lord. Lands are rich in resources, and castles are impregnable to enemies.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction10.label: Dominion
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction10.description: An aggressive dominion expanding its borders at the expense of neighbors. Military might and rulers' ambitions know no bounds.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction11.label: Vassalage
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction11.description: A network of loyal vassals bound by oaths of fealty to a suzerain. Honor and duty outweigh personal ambitions.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction12.label: Protectorate
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction12.description: A protectorate under the patronage of a powerful state. Peace and stability in exchange for tribute and troops.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction13.label: Military Alliance
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction13.description: An alliance of warlike clans hardened by constant warfare. Unity in battle is their main principle.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction14.label: Covenant
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction14.description: A mysterious covenant bound by ancient oaths and rituals. Secrecy and devotion to the cause above all.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction15.label: Confederation
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction15.description: A free confederation of cities governed by a council of elders. Each city retains autonomy.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction16.label: Despotism
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction16.description: A cruel despotism where the will of a single ruler is law for all. Rebellions are crushed mercilessly and swiftly.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction17.label: Abbey
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction17.description: A powerful abbey whose monks combine prayer with the art of war. Knowledge and faith are their strength.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction18.label: Empire
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction18.description: A multi-ethnic empire uniting peoples under the emperor's rule. Grandeur and power know no bounds.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction19.label: Conclave
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction19.description: A secret conclave of mages and scholars ruling from the shadows. Knowledge and magic are their main instruments of power.
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction20.label: Guild
LanguageData.DF_MedievalFaction20.description: A powerful guild of craftsmen and merchants controlling the economy of an entire region. Money rules the world.
